segments.title: Generic answers from AI? It doesn't know you
segments.say: If A I keeps giving you generic answers, here's why. It doesn't know your business. Fix it once, and every answer gets better.

segments.title: Tell it who you are, one time

chat.user: I own a [furniture store] in [Virginia]. My customers are [first-time home buyers]. Write in a friendly, plain tone and keep it short.
chat.ai: (Saved. Claude uses this in future chats.)

segments.say: Open Settings, find your preferences, and paste three sentences: your business, your customers, and the tone you like. Now you never repeat it.
